scenes.text: ChatGPT now *builds calculators* inside your chat

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: GPT-6 landed in ChatGPT on Oct 7 with Intelligent UI: tappable buttons, charts you can edit, built-in calculators.
Free users got it the next day. Source: TechCrunch, Oct 7, 2026.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Ask: "Build me a savings calculator for $400 a month at 5%." Slide the numbers live.
Freelancers: "Make a pricing chart for my three packages" and screenshot it for clients.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Pretty charts can hide wrong math. Check one number by hand before you trust it.
Pro reasoning mode skips the visuals for now.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Free plan: GPT-6 Luna with Intelligent UI.
